# Minutes: book fair planning

- Harbour Book Fair, 6 to 8 November, stand B14 in the translation hall. @00:30-01:00
- The stand is 850 euros; Orbex Distribution shares it and pays half. @01:00-02:00
- Cleo has two rights meetings: Hamburg and Kraków, both about The Salt Road. @02:30-03:10
- The author reads on Saturday at 15:00 in the small hall. @04:10-04:40
- Ben brings 200 copies of The Salt Road, 50 backlist titles and the catalogues. @06:10-06:40
